name: Rising Palm
description: Thrust an upturned palm into the jaw with a swell of wind and rain qi behind it.

name: Squall Brace
description: Plant the feet and wrap the torso in a coiled squall that takes the blow on its curve.

name: Gust Hop
description: Hop off the back foot on a quick lift of wind qi to leave a thrust behind.

name: Needle Rain
description: Throw a close volley of thin qi-charged streaks from the fingertips at the face and hands.

name: Sky Reading
description: Lift the face and feel the air for a change in weight that warns of a hidden strike.

name: Squall Upsurge
description: Rise from the legs on a surge of wind and rain qi and drive a palm that breaks the guard apart.

name: Squall Mantle
description: Wrap a shell of spinning squall about the body that blunts hits and lets the user slide away.

name: Rain Whip
description: Crack the wrist to send a thin slanting whip of rain qi across the opponent's forearm.

name: Sheet Guard
description: Hang a broad sheet of falling qi before the body so that thrusts glance off its wet surface.

name: Lean Step
description: Lean into the slant of the rain and step along it to slip past a swing.

name: Drench Fist
description: Punch with a fist soaked in heavy rain qi that spreads its weight through the target.

name: Streak Deflect
description: Draw a streak of qi down the forearm to carry a descending blow off to the side.

name: Rainfall Count
description: Let a fine rain of qi fall around the user and count the bodies it strikes within it.

name: Lashing Torrent
description: Fling both arms wide and loose a slanting torrent of qi that whips everyone near the user.

name: Rinsing Downpour
description: Call a gentle rain over an ally that washes poison and taint out of the skin and the blood.

name: Clap Fist
description: Punch with a sharp crack of thunder qi that rattles the bones of the struck place.

name: Rumble Guard
description: Hum a low note of thunder qi through the crossed arms so each blow is shaken apart on them.

name: Crack Step
description: Stamp and spring away with the clap of the stamp covering the first stride.

name: Rebound Clap
description: Hit once and let the qi ring back through the target so the blow lands a second time.

name: Thunderclap
description: Bring the palms together in a thunderous clap that jolts and stuns all those within arm's reach.

name: Ringing Ward
description: Meet a strike with a peal of qi that turns it and leaves the striker's ears ringing.

name: Funnel Grasp
description: Spin a small funnel of qi round an arm to pin it to the opponent's side.

name: Vortex Palm
description: Drive a palm that turns as it lands so the qi wrings the point of contact.

name: Squall Draught
description: Set a tight spinning draft about the body that drags thrown things off their course.

name: Spiral Slide
description: Slide forward in a corkscrew step that follows the turn of the funnel.

name: Whirl Cast
description: Throw a spinning disc of compressed wind qi that skims in low at the legs.

name: Rotor Sense
description: Turn slowly with a thin spiral of qi and note where it bends round a body.

name: Funnel Lift
description: Draw the opponent into a narrow funnel that lifts him off his feet and drops him hard.

name: Twisting Cyclone
description: Turn on the spot with both arms out and keep a cyclone of qi cutting around the body.

name: Calm Funnel
description: Draw the stale qi out of an ally's chest in a slow spiral and let it vent into the air.

name: Sleet Jab
description: Jab with stiff fingers wrapped in driven icy rain that stings through cloth and skin.

name: Hail Throw
description: Hurl a stone of hail from the palm that cracks when it lands.

name: Glaze Guard
description: Coat the forearms in a smooth glaze of ice that slides edges off to either side.

name: Slick Step
description: Lay a film of frost under the lead foot and skate a pace across the ground.

name: Hailstone Parry
description: Knock aside a thrust with a hard pellet of cold qi held in the fist.

name: Chilled Touch
description: Lay a freezing palm on the shoulder until the arm below it loses strength.

name: Driving Sleet
description: Sweep an arm to throw a driven cloud of icy rain across the front of the user.

name: Hailstone Barrage
description: Hurl a close run of hailstones from both palms that batter the one target.

name: Gathering Fist
description: Draw the fist slowly back as storm qi builds in it and then punch through with the whole charge.

name: Pent Guard
description: Hold the qi penned in tight against the body and let a hit pour into it unspent.

name: Pending Step
description: Wait on the balls of the feet with qi held back and then bound clear in one step.

name: Charge Read
description: Sense the charge in the air about a person to judge how much power he is holding.

name: Murmur Strike
description: Tap a quiet low blow to the body that seems nothing until the qi inside it blooms.

name: Slack Deflect
description: Go slack and let a blow slide past the loose arm before the qi snaps back taut.

name: Fraying Bolt
description: Loose a ragged forked streak of lightning qi from the palm that frays across the target's chest.

name: Held Breath Burst
description: Release the full charge in one blow that bursts outward from the point of impact.

name: Weather Break
description: Break the pent charge against an incoming technique of qi to cancel its force at the touch.

name: Squall Rinse
description: Pass a clean cool draft through an ally to blow poison fumes and fever out of the lungs.

name: Tempest Palm
description: Strike with a palm that bears wind and wet and a flash of thunder in one blow.

name: Tempest Ward
description: Spin a small tempest about the arms that throws back weak strikes and slows hard ones.

name: Tempest Stride
description: Stride out of danger on a short hard gust that carries the body clear.

name: Spark Cast
description: Cast a handful of crackling sparks from the fingertips at the eyes of the foe.

name: Pressure Drop
description: Drop the air pressure about the opponent for a moment so his breath and balance falter.

name: Tempest Braid
description: Braid wind and rain and thunder round the arm to strike and hold the target in one motion.

name: Rally Wind
description: Blow a fresh strong wind at an ally's back that quickens his stride and lifts his guard.
